description: Interviews, village walkthroughs, and contest spotlights produced by the DEF CON Video Team at DEF CON 32.

talks.title: WhiteRabbitNeo: Open-Source Red Team AI Model
talks.teaser: An interview exploring WhiteRabbitNeo, an open-source offensive security and red-teaming large language model demonstrated at DEF CON 32.

talks.title: Scanning with Daniel: Badge and RF Reconnaissance
talks.teaser: A walkthrough with Daniel exploring wireless and hardware scanning techniques across the DEF CON 32 convention floor.

talks.title: Bug Bounty Village Walkthrough
talks.teaser: A walkthrough of Bug Bounty Village at DEF CON 32 showcasing live hacking events, bounty platforms, and community workshops.

talks.title: Embedded Systems Village Spotlight
talks.teaser: A showcase of the Embedded Systems Village at DEF CON 32 highlighting firmware extraction, bus analysis, and hardware exploitation labs.

talks.title: Interview with deadmau5
talks.teaser: An interview with electronic music producer and performer deadmau5 discussing music production technology, tech culture, and DEF CON.

talks.title: OWASP at DEF CON 32

talks.title: Organizing DEF CON Groups: Global Hacker Communities

talks.title: Interview with Cory Doctorow

talks.title: Clue Hunt Winner Interview: Marco
